import Foundation.HigherHeatCubicChannelLimit
import Foundation.HigherHeatQuadraticItoBoundary

open OperatorDerivativeRewrite.Foundation
open HigherHeatPolynomialCylinders HigherHeatAnalyticCylinderDomain
open HigherHeatWeakTimeAdjoint HigherHeatThirdChannelSteps HigherHeatCubicStepIdentity
open HigherHeatCubicChannelLimit HigherHeatDyadicStepAgreement HigherHeatCompletedPairing
open HigherHeatFirstChannelRange HigherHeatQuadraticItoBoundary HigherHeatPairedDualCausality
open HigherHeatQuadraticItoFields HigherHeatAdaptedStepDuality Filter
open scoped NNReal Topology

local instance : NeZero (size 0) := ⟨by norm_num [size, HigherHeatDyadicLaws.gridSize]⟩

lemma cell_linear (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) :
    thirdChannel T (coefficientField 0 2 (by norm_num) T hT 0 1) (core terminalCylinder) =
      -24*(T:ℝ) := by
  have hx : (HigherHeatMultivariateMoments.terminal : Test 0) = MvPolynomial.X 0 := by
    change (∑ i : Fin 1, (MvPolynomial.X i : MvPolynomial (Fin 1) ℝ)) = MvPolynomial.X 0
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_one]
  have hc : cylinderOf 0 ((1:Test 0)*(MvPolynomial.X 0)^3) = terminalCylinder^3 := by
    simp only [terminalCylinder, hx, one_mul, map_pow]
  have he := congrArg (fun φ : Dual => φ (core terminalCylinder))
    (cubic_step_dual 0 T hT 0 1 (by simp))
  rw [hc] at he
  simp only [add_apply, firstChannel_terminal_zero 2 (by norm_num),
    secondChannel_terminal_zero 2 (by norm_num), zero_add] at he
  rw [← he, witness_pairing]
  norm_num

lemma constant_linear (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) :
    thirdChannel T (constantField 2 (by norm_num) T hT) (core terminalCylinder) = -24*(T:ℝ) := by
  have hc : constantField 2 (by norm_num) T hT = coefficientField 0 2 (by norm_num) T hT 0 1 := by
    rw [← constants_field_eq 0 2 (by norm_num) T hT]
    change (∑ j : Fin 1, coefficientField 0 2 (by norm_num) T hT j 1) = _
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_one]
    rfl
  rw [hc]
  exact cell_linear T hT

example (F : Fin (size 1) → Test 1) (hF : Adapted F) (M : ℝ)
    (hM : ∀ j, ‖pairing 2 (by norm_num) 1 (by norm_num) (core (cylinderOf 1 (F j)))‖ ≤ M) :
    ‖remainder 1 1 (by norm_num) F‖ ≤ 88*M := by
  have h := remainder_bound 1 1 (by norm_num) F hF M hM
  norm_num [HigherHeatDyadicLaws.duration,HigherHeatDyadicLaws.gridSize] at h
  exact h

example (F : Fin (size 2) → Test 2) (hF : Adapted F) (M : ℝ)
    (hM : ∀ j, ‖pairing 2 (by norm_num) 1 (by norm_num) (core (cylinderOf 2 (F j)))‖ ≤ M) :
    ‖remainder 2 1 (by norm_num) F‖ ≤ 40*M := by
  have h := remainder_bound 2 1 (by norm_num) F hF M hM
  norm_num [HigherHeatDyadicLaws.duration,HigherHeatDyadicLaws.gridSize] at h
  exact h

example (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) : thirdChannel T (constantField 2 (by norm_num) T hT) ≠ 0 := by
  intro hz
  have h := constant_linear T hT
  rw [hz, zero_apply] at h
  have hp : 0 < (T:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hT
  linarith

example : thirdChannel 0 = 0 := by
  ext A G
  simp [thirdChannel,coefficient]

example (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) :
    Tendsto (fun n => pairing 2 (by norm_num) T hT
      (core (cylinderOf n (cubicPolynomial n (fun _ => 1)))) (core terminalCylinder)) atTop
        (𝓝 (-24*(T:ℝ))) := by
  have he := ((ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ (core terminalCylinder)).continuous.tendsto
    (thirdChannel T (constantField 2 (by norm_num) T hT))).comp (constant_cubic_sums_converge T hT)
  change Tendsto (fun n => pairing 2 (by norm_num) T hT
    (core (cylinderOf n (cubicPolynomial n (fun _ => 1)))) (core terminalCylinder)) atTop
      (𝓝 (thirdChannel T (constantField 2 (by norm_num) T hT) (core terminalCylinder))) at he
  rw [constant_linear] at he
  exact he
